column1: # Third-party Paper plugins bundled into the Minecraft image.
# These used to exist only in the ct102 minecraft_data volume, hand-copied and
# never version-managed, so losing the volume lost them silently and upgrading
# meant an SSH session. See #336. Pinning them here makes the image
# self-contained and a version bump a reviewable diff.
# Fetched by minecraft/fetch-plugins.sh into jars/ before the Docker build.
# Every field is pinned, including the Modrinth version id and a sha512 of the
# exact artifact — the URL alone would let the contents change under us.
# To upgrade one: find the new version on Modrinth, then
# and copy version_number, the primary file's filename, url and sha512 hash.
# Check the version's game_versions actually lists the Minecraft version in
